# A method returning only an error takes the response status from the error
# when its declared type is an interface with StatusCode() int. A concrete
# type that implements error is a value: it is .Result, as any other result.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /health Healthcheck(ctx)"}}{{with .Err}}unavailable: {{.Error}}{{else}}OK{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /problem Problem()"}}{{.Result.Message}} {{.Err}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

import "context"

type StatusErr interface {
	error
	StatusCode() int
}

type ServiceUnavailableError struct{ Message string }

func (e ServiceUnavailableError) Error() string { return e.Message }

func (ServiceUnavailableError) StatusCode() int { return 503 }

type Server struct{ down bool }

func (s Server) Healthcheck(ctx context.Context) StatusErr {
	if s.down {
		return ServiceUnavailableError{Message: "database unavailable"}
	}
	return nil
}

// Problem returns a concrete type that implements error: it is data.
func (Server) Problem() ServiceUnavailableError {
	return ServiceUnavailableError{Message: "a value"}
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		server   Server
		target   string
		wantCode int
		wantBody string
	}{
		{Server{}, "/health", http.StatusOK, "OK"},
		{Server{down: true}, "/health", http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable: database unavailable"},
		{Server{}, "/problem", http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "a value "},
	} {
		mux := http.NewServeMux()
		TemplateRoutes(mux, tt.server)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.target, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.wantCode || rec.Body.String() != tt.wantBody {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want %d %q", tt.target, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), tt.wantCode, tt.wantBody)
		}
	}
}
